description: This file contains several Bash shell functions related to managing Git worktrees, particularly for handling pull request (PR) worktrees including functions to initialize worktrees, fetch PR metadata via GitHub CLI, and clean up merged or closed PR worktrees.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Determines the canonical root directory of the Git repository, handling different environments and worktree configurations.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Switches the current directory to the specified PR's worktree, creating it if necessary, and fetches the latest from origin/main.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Fetches metadata about a specific pull request from GitHub in JSON format.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Saves PR metadata JSON to a file and exports environment variables with significant PR details.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists all existing PR worktrees found in the repository, showing their statuses and URLs.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Garbage collects (removes) worktrees related to closed or merged PRs, with an option for dry run.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a given worktree directory name.
